prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: TALKPIK AI auth gateway redesign concept
Input image role: source screenshot is a reference for sign-up state and required fields only.
Primary request: Redesign 01-A-01-sign-up/default.
Direction: secure first-step gateway.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS window title bar, device frame, or watermark. The sign-up form is the main task area. Include brand promise, name, email, password and confirmation fields, password rule checklist, terms/privacy checkbox, disabled/ready sign-up CTA, Google sign-up, and login return link. Left support area may show subtle neutral mascot or learning promise.
Style/medium: high-fidelity Ant Design auth Form/Card/Button mockup with compact density.
Color palette: Mist #f4f4f5 background, Snow #ffffff form card, Fog #ececee helper surfaces, Obsidian #09090b primary CTA only.
Typography: Cosmica-like single sans, weight-based hierarchy, no letter spacing.
Constraints: make it feel like a serious Korean exam preparation tool, not a consumer AI toy; Korean UI text is visual direction only and not final copy source.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, glow effects, saturated gradients, decorative orbs, repeated chromatic accents, large bubbly radii, raw provider/error text, watermark.
